parts.label: a
parts.technique: Intersection of two vector lines (r=a+λb form)
parts.reason: Vector equation of a line and intersection of lines is explicitly listed among concepts no 9MA0 statement covers.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Angle between two lines using scalar (dot) product
parts.reason: Scalar product and angle between vectors/lines is explicitly excluded as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers; also depends on part (a)'s out-of-spec intersection point.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Area of triangle using vector magnitudes and included angle from dot product
parts.reason: Relies on the angle found via scalar product in part (b) which is out of spec, and scalar product itself is an excluded concept.
